Resolves #20695

## Summary

Adds the missing catalog records and captions for the visual component demonstrations. The 25 new records are integrated against the current 22-group catalog and keep their home groups: 17 in More components, five in Charts, Canvas & Maps, and one each in Lists & Galleries, Dialogs & Overlays and Workers & Platform.

The catalog now holds 98 records, including 31 visual component records. The six records already present on `dev` keep their landed covers, positions and captions. A record without a cover remains in the catalog without rendering a card until cover work lands separately.

The Google Maps wrapper stays out because its checked-in configuration contains a placeholder API key and does not render a usable map.

Evidence: L3 (Chromium exercised the examples; the examples unit suite and every published destination were checked) -> L3 required (running examples, destination checks and unit coverage).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | The 25 new repository examples are cataloged in their home groups; the four pre-existing repository records and two external records retain their landed group assignments. `component/wrapper/googleMaps` is the only inventory entry left out, because its configured API key remains a placeholder. |
| AC-2 | Every included example was loaded at 1440×900 against the local dev server with Playwright Chromium 1248; captions use observed controls and behavior. External-service limits are recorded in `scope`. |
| AC-3 | Captions name only visible component behavior and omit unsupported performance, production-readiness or commercial claims. |
| AC-4 | All 124 destinations for the 31 visual component records return HTTP 200 with a browser user agent and open the example's own document in all four build modes. |
| AC-5 | `playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples`: 36 passed. The six covered records still render six cards; the 25 new cover-less records remain off-card until #21120. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The integration follows the amended 16 November ticket: current `dev` group ids, current four-mode URLs and the six records already on `dev` replace the older Components-family draft.
- `component/wrapper/googleMaps` is omitted because `YOUR_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` is still configured.
- The screenshot is linked from the commit that originally added it; the final tree does not include binary PR evidence, so package-content checks remain clean.

## Test Evidence

- `playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples` → 36 passed.
- Playwright Chromium 1248 opened the included examples against the local Webpack dev server at 1440×900; no page-level JavaScript errors were observed for the included examples.
- Browser-user-agent HTTP checks against `[QUARANTINED_URL: neomjs.com]` returned 200 for all 124 destinations across the 31 visual component records.

# PR Micro-Review

**Opening**: Thank you, @guitarmanchan911-byte, specifically for two choices: you rebuilt this on the landed groups as one commit instead of stacking repairs, and you left `component/wrapper/googleMaps` out with its reason instead of cataloguing a map that cannot render. [What Neo is](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/benefits/Introduction.md); your change sits in the Portal's examples catalog, the one file every group page and the Featured list read (`apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`, documented on `apps/portal/model/Example.mjs`); [run it](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up-the-engine-from-a-clone); next, [a help-wanted issue](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/labels/help%20wanted). Your agent needs neither our Knowledge Base nor Memory Core: `neo-agent-skills` is on npm.

**Class:** mechanical — 25 catalog records in one JSON file and the assertions that pin them; no view, model or engine code changes, and a record without a cover renders no card.

**Verdict:** Request Changes

**Glance:** The claim is 25 records with captions for the visual component examples, sorted into the 22 landed groups, with nothing published until covers land. Verified at `340fa48b52`, one commit on `dev` `a442f37f3e`: the catalog holds 102 records, `dev`'s 77 plus 25; the homes follow the bound rule of #21141 (17 `components`, 5 `charts`, one each in `lists`, `dialogs` and `platform`); the six existing records differ from `dev` only by an added `component` value; all 25 have `image: null`; CI is green on this head (unit, e2e-engine, build-all, guards). I then read every caption against its example's source on `dev` and ran three examples in headless Chromium. 13 of the 25 need no change, among them one that only a run could confirm: in `video-move` the same `<video>` node survives the move. What I looked for and did not find: a changed caption or cover on an existing record, and a record in the wrong group. What I found: 12 records name a control or a behaviour the example does not have, or leave a network load out of `scope`. Each line below carries its replacement, so this is one pass over the file. Round 2 is a disposition over these lines and nothing new.

Two things that are not yours: which of these records get a cover and a card is decided per entry on #21142, and a record the slate retires is removed there. And `cesium-js` fails on a cold load in dev mode (`Cesium is not defined`: the wrapper calls `create` 50 ms after mount, `src/component/wrapper/CesiumJS.mjs:53`, before the library has arrived); the caption is right once the globe is there, the record stays, and the repair is ours.

**Findings:**

- [ ] `canvas`, `feature` and `lookFor`: no scene is rendered. The example's worker entry only logs (`examples/component/canvas/canvas.mjs`), and `offscreen` is read once at mount (`src/component/Canvas.mjs:29`, `:83`), so toggling it afterwards changes nothing. Use `feature`: "A canvas component that can hand its canvas to a worker as an OffscreenCanvas" and `lookFor`: "Change width or height in the configuration panel to resize the canvas. The example registers the canvas and draws nothing on it yet."
- [ ] `carousel`, `lookFor`: `autoRun` cannot be changed after creation (the example says so, `examples/component/carousel/MainContainer.mjs:49`; `afterSetAutoRun` has no stop branch, `src/component/Carousel.mjs:116`). Use: "Watch the slides rotate every 5.5 seconds, then resize the carousel with the height and width fields."
- [ ] `chip`, `lookFor`: the close button only fires `remove` (`src/component/Chip.mjs:211`) and the example registers no listener, so pressing it does nothing visible. Use: "Change the text or icon class, and toggle closable to show or hide the close button."
- [ ] `clock`, `feature` and `lookFor`: the face is two hands and no text (`src/component/Clock.mjs:53`); `fontSize` scales the hands. Use `feature`: "A clock face renders a settable time at an adjustable size" and `lookFor`: "Change the time to 09:45 and compare the hands, then change size and fontSize to resize the face and its hands."
- [ ] `mwc-text-fields`, `feature`: the variants sit on two tabs and the fields are stacked (`layout: {ntype: 'vbox'}`), not side by side. Use: "Filled and outlined text-field variants, on two tabs, show optional icons and helper text."
- [ ] `mwc-text-field`, `lookFor`: the button reads `check validity` and its result goes only to the browser console (`examples/component/mwc/textField/MainContainer.mjs:76`). Use: "Change the value and press check validity (the result is logged to the browser console), then toggle outlined or disabled in the configuration panel."
- [ ] `mwc-button`, `mwc-buttons`, `mwc-text-field`, `mwc-text-fields`, `scope`: empty, but each page loads Material Icons and Roboto from `fonts.googleapis.com` (its `index.html`), and dev mode imports the Material components from `unpkg.com` (`src/main/addon/Mwc.mjs:56`, `:71`). Use: "Loads Google's Material Icons and Roboto fonts over the network; dev mode also loads the Material web components from unpkg."
- [ ] `monaco-editor`, `lookFor`: there is no cursor style control; the radio group is `cursorBlinking`. Use: "Edit the sample function, then switch the editor theme and the cursor blinking mode, or toggle the minimap."
- [ ] `am-charts`, `scope`: the library is not bundled; it loads from `cdn.amcharts.com` (`src/main/addon/AmCharts.mjs:34`). Use: "Loads amCharts 4 from cdn.amcharts.com; the country values are static demonstration data."
- [ ] `toast`, `lookFor`: the fields are `position`, `slideDirection` and `ui`, and the code preview follows every field change, not the button (`examples/component/toast/MainContainerController.mjs:59`). Use: "Enter a message and watch the code preview follow each field, choose a position and a ui, then press create toast."
- [ ] `open-street-maps`, `feature` and `lookFor`: the data is 51 earthquake records, and the button hides one marker (`map.hideMarker('-13')`). Use `feature`: "An OpenLayers map shows a static set of 51 earthquake records and exposes camera, zoom and marker controls" and `lookFor`: "Fly between San Francisco and Iceland, change the zoom, then hide and restore one marker."
